parameters.title: True North Keeps Us Moving
parameters.prompt: uplifting alternative rock with a heartland Americana undertone, 118 BPM, electric guitar, warm bass, steady live drums, subtle synth atmosphere, warm clean vocal, anthemic chorus, wide modern production, emotionally resilient rather than overly triumphant
parameters.lyrics:
[Verse]
Under northern skies we find our way
Through the long blue dark before the day
Every mile leaves another line
But the road still points to true north signs

[Chorus]
True north keeps us moving
When the road is hard to see
True north keeps us moving
Toward the place we're meant to be
